mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS declines do not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO growth does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during accommodative policy periods.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined labor market indicators do not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined demand indicators do not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply-side shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined indicators do not correlate with subsequent supply-side shocks during tightening cycles.
